    std::string mainBuffer = inputString;
    std::string underscorePart;
    std::string bracketPart;

    int position = 0, currentCount = 0, maxCount = 0, maxBracketCount = 0;

    while (position < totalChars) {
        if (mainBuffer[position] == '(') {
            position++;

                bracketPart += mainBuffer[position];
                position++;

            if (position < totalChars && mainBuffer[position] == ')') {
                position++;
            }
            bracketPart += "_";
            underscorePart += "_";
        } else {
            underscorePart += mainBuffer[position];
            position++;
        }
    }
    underscorePart += "_";
    bracketPart += "_";

    // Calculate maxCount in underscorePart
    for (size_t j = 0; j < underscorePart.length(); j++) {
        if (underscorePart[j] == '_') {
            if (currentCount > maxCount) {
                maxCount = currentCount;
            }
            currentCount = 0;
        } else {
            currentCount++;
        }
    }

    // Calculate maxBracketCount in bracketPart
    currentCount = 0;
    for (size_t j = 0; j < bracketPart.length(); j++) {
        if (bracketPart[j] == '_') {
            if (currentCount > 0) {
                maxBracketCount++;
            }
            currentCount = 0;
        } else {
            currentCount++;
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxCount << " " << maxBracketCount << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
